name: Grand Counterfeit
description: Cast a counterfeit of the whole field's allies and foes alike that strikes at its makers and confuses its marks.

name: Unreal Bulwark
description: Hold a bulwark that is only an image yet stops each blow as though it were stone.

name: Specter Legion
description: March a legion of specters across the field that tramples every foe in its way.

name: Thousand Lies
description: Speak a thousand lies to the senses at once so that each foe believes a different one.

name: Phantom Passage
description: Pass through any guard or ward by making it believe that the user is not there.

name: Mind Sunder
description: Sunder the foe's trust in his own body so that the injuries he expects are dealt in truth.

name: Sense Eclipse
description: Eclipse every sense of a company so that none can act while the eclipse holds.

name: Vanish Absolute
description: Vanish from every sense and appear at any point the user can picture.

name: Worldglass
description: Set a pane of the world's glass about the field that throws back every blow at its source with weight scaling to the reserve.

name: Veil Eternal
description: Draw an unending veil over the user and the allies that holds as long as the reserve lasts.

name: Faceless Reign
description: Rule the field as one who has no face and no name so that foes cannot find a target to hate.

name: Sight Collapse
description: Collapse the sight of a multitude up to the ceiling of the Core tier in a single blinding stroke.

name: Unwritten Hour
description: Replace the last hour that every witness in range has seen with a false history that they and the world's records keep.
